verdicts.why: Row 'in the weather' glosses हवामानात, which is in the seed ('in this dreadful weather'); words are interposed (this dreadful), so it is discontiguous, not a stray.
'will call' glosses फोन करेन, which is in the seed as "I'll call"; it is a contraction, so the words are not contiguous.
'has become' glosses झालाय, which is in the seed as "It's so late"; the seed renders it as 'It's', so it is a literal gloss of a word the target sentence does not render.
दुसरीकडे is in the seed's Marathi, and the English 'before we moved' does not render 'elsewhere', so this is a literal gloss of an unrendered word.
'in the room' glosses खोलीत, which is in the seed ('in another room'); the sibling 'another' is interposed, so it is discontiguous, not a stray.
'flat' glosses आडवं, which is in the seed, which renders it as 'lie down'; the row is about its own sentence, so this is a literal gloss.
'place' glosses जागा, which is in the seed; the seed renders it as 'somewhere safe', so the row is about its own sentence.
'have been able to finish' glosses संपवता आलंय, which is in the seed as "you've been able to finish"; the contraction 've splits it, so it is not contiguous.
'to hear' is the lemma of ऐकल्या, which is in the seed as 'he's heard'; the row is about its own sentence.
असलेलं is in the seed's Marathi but 'which is' is not rendered in 'The church at the other end of the village is ugly', so it is a literal gloss of an unrendered word.
'to be seen' is the lemma of दिसतात, which is in the seed as 'I can see'; the row is about its own sentence.
'won't stay' glosses राहणार नाही, which is in the seed as "I don't get left behind"; it is a literal gloss of the seed's own words.
'to leave' is the lemma of निघताना, which is in the seed as 'leaving'; the row is about its own sentence.
'to forget' is the lemma of विसरलात, which is in the seed as 'forgotten'; the row is about its own sentence.
'let's see' glosses बघू, which is in the seed's Marathi, and the English renders it as 'Guess'; the row is about its own sentence.
'unless are' glosses असल्याशिवाय, which is in the seed as "Unless they're"; the words are fused, so they are not contiguous.
'in doing' glosses करण्यात, which is in the seed; the English 'worrying about' does not render the 'in' part.
'very' glosses खूप, which is in the seed; the English renders it as 'so', so it is a literal gloss.
'to wait' is the lemma of वाट पाहतोय, which is in the seed as 'waiting'; the row is about its own sentence.
'about this' glosses याची, which is in the seed's Marathi; the English has 'about how you're going to pay', so it is not rendered contiguously.
